paite: Huan siampu lianpen in, "Hiai thute adik ahi na hia?" achi hi.
heading: Stephen Thugen
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

paite: Stephen in, “Unaute aw, pate aw, ngai un. I pu Abraham, Haran a a-om ma, Mesopotamia gam a a-om lai a, thupina Pathian akiang a hong kilak in akiang ah,
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

paite: 'Na kholam leh na chite lak a kipan pawt inla, gam ka hon etsak ding lam ah pai in,' " achi hi.
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

paite: Huan amah tuh Kaldaite gam a kipan apaikhia a, Haran ah ava om a; huan apa sih nung in huai a kipan in tua na omna kholam uah Pathian in apemlutsak hi.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

paite: Huan hiai ah zaw mun luah ding, khe ngakna tham bangmah ape kei. Himahleh tapa aneih ma nangawn in ama gou ding leh anung a asuante gouluah ding in gam piak achiam hi.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

paite: Pathian in hichibang in agen, asuante mi kholam ah kum zali ataam ding ua mi'n sikha in abawl ding ua, asawi behlap ding uh.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

paite: Pathian in, " ‘Sikha a nei dingte nam keima'n ka ngaihtuah ding a, huai khit chiang in ahong pawt ding ua, hiai mun ah ka nna asem ding uh,' achi behlap hi.
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

paite: Pathian in akiang ah tua zeksum thu akhung a; huchi in Abraham in Isak asuang a, ani giat ni in azek asum a, huan Isak in Jakob asuang a; Jakob in suangtubul ding sawm-le-nihte ahon nei hi.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

paite: "Huai suangtubul dingte'n Joseph ahaza ua, Aigupta gam ah azuak ua; himahleh akiang ah Pathian a-om hi.
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

paite: Agimthuak tengteng ah ahunkhe zel a, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh deihsakna angahsak a, mipiltak ahi chih atheisak behlap hi; huchi in ama'n Aigupta gam leh a-inn a mi tengteng tung ah gam-ukpa in abawlta hi.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

paite: Aigupta leh Kanaan gam tengteng ah kial ahong tung a, gimthuakna thupitak ahong tungta hi; i pipute'n lah nek ding himhim amuta kei ua.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

paite: Himahleh Jakob in Aigupta gam ah buh a-om chih azaktak in i pipute asawlkhia a; huai tuh ahoh pat tungna pen uh ahi.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

paite: Huan anihvei hohna uah, a-unaute kiang ah Joseph kitheisakta a, huchi in Joseph chite tuh Pharaoh kiang ah akitheisakta uhi.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

paite: Huan Joseph in apa Jakob leh a-unau tengteng mi sawmsagih leh nga asamsak hi.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam ah Jakob ahohsuk a; huai ah amah leh i pipute asita uhi.
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

paite: Shekem ah apotung ua, Abraham in Shekem a Emmor tapate lak a dangka sum a alei han ah avuita uhi.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

paite: "Pathian in Abraham kiang a athuchiam ahong tun ding in Aigupta gam ah mite ahong pung ua, ahong tam deuhdeuh uhi.
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

paite: Huan Aigupta gam ah Joseph thei lou kumpi dang khat ahong lal hi.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

paite: Huai mi in i chipihte akhem a, i pipute asawi a, anaungekte uh hing lou ding in apaikhesak hi.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

paite: Huai lai in Mosi ahong piang a, Pathian muh in melhoih mahmah ahi; apa inn ah kha thum akem uhi.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

paite: Akoihkhiak un Pharaoh tanu in ama tapa ding a la in akem hi.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

paite: Huan Aigupta gam a pilna tengteng Mosi ahilh ua, thu ah leh athilhih ah athupi mahmah hi.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

paite: "Huan amah kum sawmli achin kuan in, a-unau, Israel suante aveh hi.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

paite: Huan alak ua mi khat gimthuak lai amu a, apanpih a, ahihgimpa Aigupta mi athat a, aphu alaksakta hi.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

paite: Mosi in ama khut in Pathian in amaute ahondam chih a-unaute'n thei na uhiam asa a, himahleh athei kei uh.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

paite: Huan azing in alak ua mi nih akilai un akiang uh ava naih a, 'Pute aw, unau nei ve ua; bangziak a dikloutak a kibawl na hi ua?' chi in lep atum hi.
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

paite: Himahleh a-invengpa tung a thugilou bawl zaw pen in Mosi tuh asawnhang a, koute tung a heutu leh vaihawm ding a kua'n hon bawl ahia?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

paite: Zan a Aigupta mi na thah bang a hon thah tum na hi maw? achi hi.
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

paite: Huai thu ziak in Mosi ataimangta a, Midian gam ah ataam nilouh a, huai ah tapa nih ava nei hi.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

paite: "Huan kum sawmli nung in Sinai Tang gamdai ah; loubuk ah meikuang lak ah angel khat akiang ah ahong kilak hi.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

paite: Mosi in amuh in, athil muh tuh lamdang asa mahmah a; huan en ding a apai lai in, Toupa aw in:
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

paite: 'Kei na pipute Pathian, Abraham’ Pathian, Isak' Pathian, Jakob' Pathian, ka hi,' ana chi hi. Huchi in Mosi aling a a-en ngamta kei hi.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

paite: Huan Toupa'n akiang ah, 'Na khepek a kipan na khetuam suah in; na dinna Mun Siangthou ahi,' achi hi.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

paite: Aigupta gam a om ka mite gimdan ka mu gige hi, athum uh leng ka za gige, amau hunkhe ding in ka hong suk hi. Hong in, Aigupta gam ah ka hon sawl ding," achi hi.
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

paite: "Kou tung a heutu leh vaihawm ding a kua'n hon bawl ahia, chi a adeih louh uh, Mosi, loubuk a angel kilak tungtawn in, Pathian in amah mah heutu leh hunkhepa hikhawm ding in asawlta hi.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

paite: Ama'n Aigupta gam ah Tuipi San leh gamdai mun ah, kum sawmli sung in thillamdang leh chiamtehnate amusak phot a, amaute apikheta ahi.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah, 'Pathian in keimah bang in, na unaute lak a mi zawlnei khat, athu na ngaihkhiak ding uh ahon bawlsak ding chipa Mosi ahi.
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

paite: Hiai mi ahi gamdai a omkhawmte lak a ompa, Sinai Tang a angel in ahoupihpa leh i pipute kiang a ompa; huai mi eite hon piaksawn ding a thuhingte lasawnpa mah ahi.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

paite: "I pipute'n amah thu amang kei ua, ahua ua, Aaron kiang ah,
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

paite: 'I makai ding in pathiante hon bawlsak in; Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhepa Mosi lah atanchin ka thei nawnta kei uhi,' chi in alungtang uh Aigupta gam lam ah anga nawnta uhi.
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

paite: Huai lai in bawngnou lim abawl ua, amai a kithoihna alan ua amau khutsuak milim tung ah akipak uhi.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in alehngatsan a, van a aksi abiak theihna ding un amaute akilehngat santa hi. Zawlnei laibu a, ‘Aw nou Israel inkote aw, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung in gan sisan a kithoih in thillat toh in kei na hon bia ua eita?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

paite: Molok biakna maitam leh na pathian uh, Remphan aksi leh, na milim bawltawmte uh, vialpuak in biak ding in na zong ua, huaiziak in Babulon kho khen lam ah sal in ka hon pomang ding,' chih gelh bang in.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

paite: "I pi-le-pute'n gamdai ah theihpihna biakbuk, Mosi kiang a theihsak a a-om bang leh alim amuhsak bang in ana bawl uhi.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

paite: Huai biakbuk mah i pipute suansawnte'n leng aneisawn zel ua, Pathian in i pipute ma a Zentel adelhkhiakte gam aluah lai un, Joshua makaih in biakbuk alutpih uhi. David hong om tan in huai ah a-om gige a,
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

paite: amah Pathian mitmuh a deihsakna tang, Jakob' Pathian a ding in inn bawlsak angen hi.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

paite: Himahleh Solomon in huai inn alamsak zawta hi.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

paite: "Himahleh zawlnei gen bang in khut a bawl innte ah Tungnungpen a-om kei;
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

paite: "Toupa'n van ka tutphah ahi a, lei ka khepek ngakna ahi; inn bangchibang na hon lamsak ding ua? Ka khawlna mun ding koi mun ahia?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

paite: Hiai thilte keimah khut in ka bawl kei a hia?" chi a, agen bang in.
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

paite: "Migenhakte, lungtang leh bil a zeksumlouhte aw, chik lai peuh in Kha Siangthou na dal gige uh; na pipute uh hih bang in na hih nilouh uhi.
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

paite: Na pipute un zawlneite lak ah kua ahia asawi louh uh? Mi Diktak hong ding thu genkholte athat ua; huai midiktak mansakte leh thatte noumau na hi uhi.
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

paite: Dan angelte piaksawn mu masa a zuiloute aw," achi hi.
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

paite: Huan huai thu azak un asin uh athakta a, Stephen tung ah aha uh agawita uhi.
heading: Jesu Muhna leh Stephen Sihna
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

paite: Himahleh amah Kha Siangthou in adim a, van lam a-en a, Pathian thupina leh Pathian taklam a Jesu dingh amu hi.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

paite: "Ngai un, van kihong ka mu a, Pathian taklam a Mihing Tapa dingh leng ka mu," achi hi.
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

paite: Huchi in amau aw ngaihtak in akikou ua, abil uh ahum ua,
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

paite: kituaktak in apang ua, khua a kipan adelhkhia ua, suang in adeng ua, atheihpihte'n tangval khat amin Saul khebul ah apuante uh akoihkhawm chiat uhi.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

paite: Amaute'n Stephen suang in adengta ua; ama'n Pathian sam in, "Toupa Jesu, ka kha la in," achi hi.
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

paite: Huan khukdin in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Toupa, hiai akhelhna tung uah moh posak ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in huai agen zoh in, a-ihmuta hi.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
